title: Football Jersey Design (2026)
verdict: Football jersey design in 2026 is about numbers first and everything else second. Wooter's builder has football styles that leave the numbers room, and its designers will create an original for free.
Champro and Nike Team offer template libraries through dealers. Custom Ink covers printed and stock sublimated designs.

why: Start with the numbers. They are the biggest thing on the jersey, officials and scouts rely on them, and high school rules govern their size, style and contrast with the jersey.
Then spend your one idea on the shoulders or sleeves: stripes, a pattern or a logo. The body mostly disappears under pads and a tucked hem.
Finish with the helmet and pants in mind. A jersey that matches both looks deliberate.

criteria.name: Contrast
criteria.text: Numbers that separate from the body.

faq.q: What makes a football jersey legal for high school?
faq.a: NFHS rules cover number size, style and color contrast, and numbers run 0 through 99. Get the current rule sheet from your state association before approving a design.

faq.q: Where can a design go on a football jersey?
faq.a: Shoulders, sleeves and side panels. Keep the chest and back clear for numbers.

faq.q: Should home be dark or white?
faq.a: Most rules put the home team in dark and visitors in white.
